chapters.title: The accounts payable challenge and AI solution
Inbound e-document list and purchase document draft pages
Building blocks and public preview timeline

features.name: Payables Agent
features.description: An AI agent that streamlines the accounts payable process from receiving invoices through posting, applying accounting knowledge to handle the last mile of invoice processing that typically requires human intervention.
features.status_evidence_quote: we aim for this agent to be available for public preview somewhere in the second half of 2025
caveats: Users can configure where humans enter the workflow
Purchase document draft page is in early stages and may be adjusted

features.name: E-document connector for Microsoft 365
features.description: A connector enabled through an e-document service that imports PDF attachments from Microsoft 365 mailbox, SharePoint, or OneDrive to source PDF invoices from various channels.

features.name: Inbound e-document list page
features.description: A go-to page for every e-document received, whether from SharePoint, Outlook, or electronic invoicing channels. Supports PDFs and other incoming vendor invoices from e-invoicing channels.

features.name: Purchase document draft page
features.description: A page where the agent suggests how to register invoices, whether to defer or split expenses across departments, and displays a PDF preview. Users or agents assess draft invoices and finalize them into real purchase invoice documents.
caveats: In early stages with potential adjustments
Page may be adjusted as development continues

features.name: Intelligent accounting for invoice processing
features.description: Built into the agent to capture accounting knowledge that typically resides in bookkeepers and accountants, enabling the system to create purchase invoices and learn from existing practices.
features.status_evidence_quote: we aim for this agent to be available for public preview somewhere in the second half of 2025

features.name: Three-way matching and purchase order mapping
features.description: A roadmap capability that will enable invoices to be matched to purchase orders, allowing three-way matching between the invoice, purchase order, and receipt.
caveats: Part of future roadmap beyond initial public preview

features.name: Invoice approval workflow
features.description: A planned capability to support invoice approval with easy access to view the original PDF document, enabling approval scenarios both within Business Central and outside of it.
